entities.title: Operation fixtures
entities.summary: Executable fixtures for the everyday API (everyday.json) and the text form (text-form.json).
entities.purpose: The arbiter of what every library's JSON layer returns: each fixture gives an operation or a text, its arguments and the expected status, diagnostic codes and result.
boundaries: The expected values of everyday.json were computed with Python's datetime and zoneinfo, independently of the UTV libraries.
Zone-dependent fixtures use the rule bundle everyday.json names under rules (conformance/rules/demo-zones.json).
